Elena — thanks for the projection, and great to hear the demo resonated. Quick summary of options we typically offer (tailored to a 36-month, multi-site commit):

Option A — Standard platform fee + metered consumption
- One-time platform fee at signature (covers private control plane setup, onboarding, 6 months of monitoring retention).
- Metered vGPU-hour pricing thereafter; support charged as standard per-incident or bronze retainer.

Option B — Amortized platform fee (preferred for mid-size deals)
- Platform fee amortized monthly across the committed term (reduces initial cash outlay).
- Lower per-vGPU rate when amortized is elected.

Option C — Support-amplified discount
- Higher annual support retainer (silver or gold) in exchange for a platform fee reduction and additional response SLAs.

I'll attach a sketch (spreadsheet) with a worked example against the numbers you shared. Two clarifying questions for alignment:
1) For the EU site, do you require separate KMS/HSM for keys (this affects implementation effort)?
2) Will data residency require us to deploy separate private control planes per region?

Looping Grace (our head of CS pricing) to outline support tiers and potential retainer levels. If that looks reasonable I can put a draft SOW + pricing spreadsheet on DocuSign for you to review.

— Jonas
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Hi Elena / Jonas,

Thanks Jonas — hi Elena, quick note on support tiers and how they interact with platform fee treatment:

- Bronze: per-incident support, standard SLAs (24/48 business hours). No platform fee credit.
- Silver: annual retainer, 24/7 monitoring + 8x5 SRE on-call, reduced incident prioritization windows; eligible for up to 25% platform fee deferment or 10% platform fee reduction (depending on commit).
- Gold: higher retainer, includes runbook handover, 1-hr critical response SLA, account SRE sessions; eligible for up to 40% platform fee reduction + signed implementation milestone credits.

Operational tranches we commonly propose for multiyear deals: initial onboarding tranche (paid up-front, covers setup), staggered amortization (monthly/quarterly), and a contingency pool for burst capacity (pre-purchased credits). If MedForge needs to cap cash flow, Option B + Silver typically hits the sweet spot.

I've attached the support tier matrix. Happy to map your projection to effective per-vGPU-hour line items if you send final traffic assumptions.

— Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Support-Tier-Matrix.pdf (pdf)

Can you get a worked proposal and a marked-up SOW by EOD Friday PST? We're hoping to present to finance next Tuesday.

Elena
